name: Crop Harvest MC
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: v_modding
description: Harvest crops with right click and automatically replant them using seeds from your inventory.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: In survival, using grown wheat with wheat seeds in the inventory cuts it and replants it at age 0, using up a seed. With the mod turned off, the same use leaves the wheat grown.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged. It harvests only in survival, as the mod itself does.
